name: aiko-dev
description: Top-level dev runner for the Aiko assistant (FastAPI backend + Vite React frontend).

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,web --prefix-colors magenta,cyan "python -m app.web" "npm --prefix web run dev"
scripts.desktop: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,web,tauri --prefix-colors magenta,cyan,green "python -m app.web" "npm --prefix web run dev" "npm --prefix web run tauri:dev"
scripts.tauri: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names web,tauri --prefix-colors cyan,green "npm --prefix web run dev" "npm --prefix web run tauri:dev"
scripts.lint: npm run lint:py && npm run lint:web
scripts.lint:py: python -m ruff check app tests scripts
scripts.lint:py:fix: python -m ruff check --fix app tests scripts
scripts.lint:pylint: node -e "const { spawnSync } = require('node:child_process'); const python = process.platform === 'win32' ? '.venv/Scripts/python.exe' : '.venv/bin/python'; const result = spawnSync(python, ['-m', 'pylint', '--rcfile=pyproject.toml', '--reports=n', '--score=n', ...process.argv.slice(1)], { stdio: 'inherit' }); if (result.error) console.error(result.error.message); process.exit(result.status ?? 1);" --
